meta.name: Send daily AI credits report with FAL AI, OpenRouter, Apify, and Telegram

name: AI API Expense Tracker- FAL, APIFY and Open Router

parameters.content:
## Expense Tracker- FAL, APIFY and Open Router

### How it works

This workflow runs on a schedule to track account expenses and remaining credits across FAL AI, OpenRouter, and Apify. It queries each provider API in sequence, consolidates the returned usage data with a JavaScript code node, and sends the resulting summary to Telegram.

### Setup steps

- Configure the Schedule Trigger with the desired checking frequency.
- Add valid API authentication for the FAL AI billing request, OpenRouter credits request, and Apify usage request in their respective HTTP Request nodes.
- Configure the Telegram node with bot credentials and the target chat ID for receiving the expense summary.
- Review the JavaScript code node to ensure it matches the response formats returned by the three provider APIs.

### Customization

You can adjust the schedule, add more provider credit endpoints, change the summary formatting in the JavaScript node, or route alerts to another notification channel instead of Telegram.

## Scheduled start

Starts the workflow on a configured schedule so expense and credit balances can be checked automatically.

## Fetch service credits

Calls the FAL AI, OpenRouter, and Apify APIs in sequence to retrieve current billing, credits, and usage information from each service.

## Format and notify

Combines the collected API responses in JavaScript, prepares a readable summary, and sends it as a Telegram text message.
